title.en: No partial video after an interruption

detail.zh-CN: 写出视频时被打断，输出位置上不会再留下不完整的文件，接续也不会因此报“输出已存在”。
detail.en: If a render is cut off while writing the video, no incomplete file is left at the output path, so resuming no longer fails with "Output already exists".

title.zh-CN: 看得到进程退出的原因
title.en: See why a render process died

detail.zh-CN: 软件启动的渲染意外退出时，作业详情显示它最后的错误输出；没有错误输出时，说明常见原因并提示开启托管。
detail.en: When a render started by the app exits unexpectedly, the job details show its last error output; if there is none, they explain the usual cause and point to hosting.

title.zh-CN: agent 为长渲染留足时间

detail.zh-CN: agent 会给渲染留足命令超时或放到后台运行；命令被打断时接续原作业，不再从头重渲。
detail.en: Agents give renders a long enough command timeout or run them in the background, and resume the job instead of starting over when the command is cut off.
